notes.title: 🔁 Erebus Update is live a Kickstarter! 🔁
notes.content:
Thanks so much for the progress! Everyday is a new one. We are very happy to get close to 40%!

But today is a special one, we have updated the demo with... a lot of new content and many Quality Of Life features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001013/2e88e9b3147d873405101b8dcb7bd696e2aced27.gif[/img]

Many of them will be hard to feel but the difference is massive to us.

In the main changeset we love :

Controls should be much better with gamepad, we worked a lot for the game to feel less rigid
Erebus allows you to learn about characters and start with some stuff before hand and , it is still not balanced but it was our last big system to dev before our "vertical slice" version.

Overall weapon balance and fixes, they will have more diversity and gamefeel will be better!

Thanks everyone for supporting us until there 🖤
In case you need our link to the Kickstarter! [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/headbangclub/deathtower-the-overclocked-roguelite-tactical-rpg]KICKSTARTER![/url]

Here is our new artwork in case you don't already follow our Kickstarter!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001013/2cdf7ef8cd20026ec1336bc0a17b3a7715b6da77.png[/img]

notes.title: proto rc9 87
notes.content:
Hey! 

Demo was out two weeks ago!
It contains the "tutorial" segment which takes you to the first boss!

And now it is patched with the hotfixes :

proto rc9 87
- fixed the resolution bug when windows desktop was zoomed which is getting common these days.
- started preliminary work on hijy.
- prevent crash on cutscenes.
- change colors of the credits because it's essential and fixed typos in it.
- rebalanced weapons spread and distribution : it will be reworked in the future.
- can no longer flee using starter elevator.
- topology is not updated properly after push actions.
- weapon range now update when changing action hover.
- erebus still in progress.
- floor complete screen slightly less ugly but will be rebuilt from scratch in the future
- gameplay hints now can be blocked with a prompt.
- prevent looting crashes.
- moved music around and shipped new explo/battle music!
- option menu has a better navigation.
- updated some levels and polishes visuals.
- loops not yet accessible.
- stay tuned and have fun.

As we are still looking for funding and support, we will try to update the demo every month.
If you liked what you played or what you see, you can help by spreading the word, registering for the kickstarter and giving feeedback. We read everything don't worry if we don't react.
Cheers!
